input.title: Password manager explainer (12 s)
input.style: Flat explainer (friendly flat illustration, Back Out pops, Cubic/Quart Out moves, Expo In for suction)
input.styleReason: Flat explainer suits a one-idea-per-beat product story with friendly colors.

beats.name: Problem: sticky-note pile
beats.description: A messy pile of 5-6 colored sticky notes, each with a password line (dots and short strings), pops in with Back Out and jitters anxiously with small fast rotation wobbles. Hands over by pulling the notes toward the center as beat 2 begins.
beats.style: Back Out pops 0.3-0.4s, staggered 0.08s; anxious jitter at ~1.5 Hz, ±3°; coral, teal, amber notes on cream #FFF8F0, navy ink #22313F.

beats.name: Gather: notes sucked into the vault
beats.description: Notes spiral on arcs into a navy shield/vault icon at center (Expo In suction, staggered), shrinking as they enter. The shield pops in early (overlapping the end of beat 1) so the notes have a target. Shield flashes a single pulse as the last note lands.
beats.style: Expo In for the pull, shield Back Out pop, no hard cut: notes shrink into the shield's center point.

beats.name: Resolve: glow, check, headline
beats.description: Shield glows (soft amber halo pulse), a teal check mark draws on inside it (trimEnd 0-100, Cubic In Out 0.5s). Headline 'One key. Every login.' lands below in Inter 700 ~72px navy, word-by-word rise, settling and holding to the end.
beats.style: Cubic Out / Quart Out moves, check draw 0.5s, headline fade-up 0.5s; final frame holds ≥2s for reading.

input.notes: Palette: background #FFF8F0, ink #22313F, coral #FF7F50, teal #2EC4B6, amber #FFBF69, navy #3D5A80, white highlights. Font: Inter. No gradients, one radius family (12-24). 1920x1080 30fps. Open question: keep the headline on the final frame with the shield above it (planned), not a separate end card.
